recognize_zh: 骨髓抽取抹片中央一顆巨大細胞，細胞質豐富、淡藍灰色並有細密纖維狀條紋，像皺摺的衛生紙（wrinkled tissue paper），這是 Gaucher 細胞；細胞本身的核在此圖不易辨認，其上重疊的粉紅色核應為其他造血細胞。
features: Very large cell with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm showing fine fibrillary, striated texture (wrinkled tissue paper or crumpled silk appearance)
The cell's own nucleus is not clearly discernible; nuclei overlying the cytoplasm appear to belong to superimposed hematopoietic cells
No discrete vacuoles or ingested cells within the cytoplasm
Background of mixed granulocytic and erythroid precursors
Red cells show a gray-green tint consistent with a staining artifact
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows mixed granulocytic and erythroid precursors with a staining artifact imparting a gray-green tint to red cells. A very large histiocytic cell with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm displaying a fine fibrillary, wrinkled tissue paper texture is present; its nucleus is not clearly delineated, with overlying hematopoietic cells superimposed on the cytoplasm. No soap-bubble vacuolation, hemophagocytosis or organisms are seen. Findings are consistent with a Gaucher cell, and confirmation by glucocerebrosidase activity or GBA1 testing is recommended.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cell (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells look nearly identical but occur with an underlying neoplasm or infection and normal glucocerebrosidase activity.

ddx.dx: Niemann-Pick cell (sea-blue histiocyte or foam cell)
ddx.vs: Niemann-Pick cells have uniform soap-bubble vacuoles or sea-blue granules rather than fibrillary striated cytoplasm.
Megakaryocytes have a lobulated nucleus and finely granular lilac cytoplasm without striations.
Hemophagocytes contain engulfed red cells, platelets or nucleated cells within vacuoles rather than homogeneous striated cytoplasm.
